v265.auxiliary_note: Canonical compound examples use avoir. A reflexive construction uses être, even when the non-reflexive verb uses avoir.

v265.usage_note: Use the complement and preposition appropriate to the intended sense. Finite reference forms do not include a subject pronoun. See the contextual usage example and sentence patterns.
